title: Weather and Aftermath
author: Isandro Eastwick
blurb: Felix Underhill, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
